scope: Fresh dist read-only audit; only this evidence JSON was written.

backgroundTextureTuning.finding: background anchorPoint, scale and resizeBlocked are emitted in the public texture slot but ignored by the raw background renderer.
backgroundTextureTuning.status: Confirmed by source inspection; no browser claim.

evidence.detail: Raw scene.add.image uses viewport center, native frame dimensions, and cover fit. It never reads getTextureSlot(background) or anchorPoint/scale/resizeBlocked.
DesignImage applies slot anchorPoint, scale and resizeBlocked. Background is not created with this wrapper.
SLOT_NOTES for background explicitly says anchorPoint, scale and resizeBlocked are not used.

backgroundTextureTuning.impact: Editor changes to these three background fields have no effect; replacing path still affects the rendered background.
